title: Bug: the MCP health check bounds the length of one reply line
objective: Add src/wev_skills/third_party/health.py with health checks for a third-party version: for the rea MCP source start the server through npx, speak newline-delimited JSON-RPC over its stdio (initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list) and report how many tools it lists; for a skills source check that the skill files are valid; for a wev source run the version's own check. Each check is bounded in time and in the size of what it reads, and reports a HealthReport(ok, code, params).
